title: Opsis semantic model
description: One model per dataset. Defines the dimensions, measures, joins, segments and row-level security rules that semantic queries may use. The same shape is used for YAML import and export (models/<dataset>.yml), where a top-level `dataset` key names the dataset. This schema checks structure; the backend then checks that columns exist, expressions are safe, and references resolve.

segments.description: Named filters, usable in a query's `segments` list.

rls.description: Row-level security. Every rule that applies to the user's role is ANDed. A rule whose user attribute is missing or empty denies all rows.

expression.description: A single SQL expression. Only plain column names of this dataset, literals, operators, CASE, CAST and a fixed list of scalar functions are allowed. No subqueries, no table functions, no aggregates.

grains.description: Time dimensions only. Defaults to every grain.

timezone.description: Time dimensions only. The IANA timezone a timestamp without an offset was written in, for example UTC for Salesforce. Defaults to the workspace timezone. Timestamps are converted to the workspace timezone before grouping and filtering. Not needed for columns that already carry an offset (they are stored as instants) or for dates.

column.description: Required for every aggregation except count, where omitting it counts rows.

expr.description: Arithmetic over other measures of this dataset, written in braces: {total_amount} / NULLIF({gift_count}, 0).

filter.description: Makes an aggregation conditional: only rows matching this condition are counted. A boolean expression over the dataset's columns; a segment can be used by name in braces. Examples: channel = 'Online', or {large} AND region = 'VIC'. Only for measures with `agg`.

format.description: A format name for display, for example number, percent or currency_aud.

on.description: Column of this dataset to column of the other dataset.

relationship.description: Only many_to_one and one_to_one joins can be used in queries, because the others would double-count measures.

filter.description: A boolean expression over this dataset's columns. May reference {{ user.attributes.<name> }}, {{ user.email }} and {{ user.role }}. Example: region IN {{ user.attributes.regions }}
